data.key: Summon Nature's Ally VII (swimming creatures only)
data.description: This spell functions like summon nature's ally I, except that you can summon one 7th-level swimming creature, 1d3 6th-level swimming creatures of the same kind, or 1d4+1 lower-level swimming creatures of the same kind.
